|Hr = Journal
|Pointed, darting insect that builds a hardy hive from Shellwood's dried bark.<hr/>Destroying the hives will limit their presence in the wood. Useful to me now, as I pass along the branches. Dangerous in time for the wood's order. Even a small disruption can tip a fragile balance.

<b>Wood Wasps</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are tiny, purplish wasps with bulging eyes. They are often found near their nests.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
When idle, Wood Wasps hover around a small area. When Hornet approaches, they fly towards her and attack by charging at her in a straight line. If they hit a surface while charging, they are stuck briefly before dislodging themselves.

Wood Wasps deal {{Damage|1}} both upon contact and with their attack.

They spawn regularly from the destructible purple hives found in Shellwood when Hornet is nearby, starting with a maximum of 2 wasps out at once and increasing to 3 once the hive drops to 16 health.
Once their hive is destroyed, 1–2 wasps will continue to respawn around the area of their hive.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Wood Wasps have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Wood Wasps can be found in [[Shellwood]], often surrounding their hives or intact [[Pollip Heart]] flowers.

==Trivia==
* Wood Wasp is an alternate name for [[wikipedia:Horntail|Horntails]], a real life species of sawflies.
* [[Pollip Heart]]s are dead bodies of Wood Wasps, consumed by the purple plant from which the Pollip Hearts are dropped.<ref>Pollip Heart description: <i>"Core of a flower formed around the body of a consumed Wood Wasp."</i></ref>
